info.title: Blakeswap daemon API
info.description: Local wallet API. All amounts are integer satoshis. Protobuf JSON represents int64 as decimal strings. Bearer credentials are read from a private runtime file. HTTP binds only to loopback; gRPC binds to a private Unix socket.

v1ActionSummaryRequest.description: Refresh queues bounded all-wallet worker reconciliation; this read never waits on nodes.

v1AutomationEdit.description:
Two-stage exact authorization. Saving validates the complete review digest and
revision; it never edits existing signed orders or subtracts committed spending.

v1AutomationRate.description: Exact BLAKE satoshis per BTC satoshi; positive bounded integer ratio.

unconfirmed.description: Below the network's required confirmation depth.

htlc_locked.description: Observed unspent own contract principal, separate from deposit coins.

htlc_available.description: False means contract observations are unavailable, never zero by inference.

v1CoinHold.description: A coin may have multiple owners; its amount is counted once in reserved_confirmed.

v1ConfirmTradeRequest.description:
Keep this exact identity through an uncertain response. A persisted receipt
returns the same accepted result after restart/expiry, never a second trade.

tower_pubkey.description: Selected discovered provider; ignored when protection is off.

expected_network.description: Must match the active desktop network.

explorers.description: Optional per-chain transaction URL templates containing {txid}; no default explorer is guessed.

public_watchtower.description: Off by default; private npub lookup remains available.

favorite_watchtowers.description: Provider npubs, scoped to this network.

rescue_fee_bps.description: Own wallets' rescue rate: 1–1000 basis points; 0 retains the 50 bps default.

v1FeeEstimate.description: Rates are native chain satoshis per 1000 virtual bytes, rounded upward.

source_event_id.description: Exact current own offer for replacement funding only.

state.description: proven, not_proven, checking, unavailable (not_applicable for Blake).

expected_network.description: Inputs omitted selects the actual automatic funding candidate set.

refund_locktime.description: Legacy JSON alias; block height on regtest, median-time Unix timestamp on public networks.

owner.description: all, mine, others; independent of side.

side.description: all, buy_btc, sell_btc from the selected wallet's perspective.

status.description: all, open, pending, reserved, filled, cancelled, expired, refunded.

btc_max.description: Exact BTC satoshis; zero means unbounded.

fallbacks.description: Ordered after this primary; at most three, without nested fallbacks.

kind.description: electrum or rpc; all chain backends are external.

url.description: ssl://host:port or tcp://loopback:port for Electrum; HTTPS/loopback HTTP for RPC.

cookie.description: Absolute path to an RPC cookie file. The API never returns its contents.

certificate_sha256.description: Optional explicit SHA256 of the Electrum server's DER certificate.

max_fee.description: Original replacement cap; zero disables fee increases.

onboarding_stage.description: wallet, backup, connect; empty means completed. Older installs remain completed.

wallets.description: Stable IDs; display names may be edited. Create IDs with CreateWallet.

revision.description: Compare-and-swap revision: stale updates are rejected.

v1StrategySide.description: Explicit two-asset maker authorization. All money is native integer satoshis.

tower_bps.description: This wallet's private protection; zero disables it.

tower_pubkey.description: Selected discovered provider, never sent to the maker.

event.description: Signed provider announcement pinned to a protected offer.

order_action.description: Empty creates/takes normally; maker may replace or recreate.

v1TradeQuoteRequest.description:
Read-only review. Amounts describe the maker's signed offer/draft; the response
orients economics to the selected wallet. Every fee is native to its chain.
